historical_context.time_period: Industrial Greathold during early coordinated dungeon responses and before a viable contraction plan exists
historical_context.location: Cistern House Nine, a public pump workshop serving terraces beside one Hold's warm underground sea.
historical_context.summary: A routine monthly covenant review becomes a political choice when a Deep Company halves its crystal shipment and the reserve house conditions emergency stock on a Forge Consortium retrofit and longer debt.

public_facts.text: Cistern House Nine has a public landing, dry rune gallery, wet intake chamber, three visible pumps, locked municipal crystal feed, pressure floats, isolation hardware, and a workshop civic seal.
Reserve houses hold crystal, parts, and callable credit for named infrastructure webs under mandates assembled by affected workshop seals.
A reserve factor may approve or refuse a claim and impose financial consequences, but cannot seize a workshop's civic seal or multiply votes.
Standardized supplier parts may be cheaper to insure while narrowing the skills, spares, and contracts available to a municipal workshop.

ambient_pressures.text: The terrace public needs water now, while the reserve mandate and supplier terms distribute costs across later winters.
Deep Company route failure and attacks on standardized substations make both supply scarcity and the proposed standard materially plausible without proving a single directing mind.
Every available response has a constituency: factors want insurable risk, consortiums want a stable standard, workers want repairable machinery, and water users want service plus an answerable owner.

groups.label: Cistern House Nine workshop
institutional_logic: Keep terrace water moving through inspectable, repairable machinery.
Bind service decisions to one answerable workshop seal.
material_incentives: Keep debt service below workshop revenue.
Preserve local parts and repair knowledge.
internal_virtues: A boundary that exists in iron as well as ink
internal_shames: A part nobody local can repair
Hiding a public cost in a private ledger
prestige_markers: A gauge the landing can read
A part that fits more than one maker's engine
A service record usable by the next shift
taboo_triggers: A creditor treating the civic seal as collateral
A catalogue declaring compatibility against a failed physical gauge
emotional_display_norms: Anxiety becomes measurement, dry jokes, work assignments, and exact objections before it becomes confession.
trust_defaults: Trusts physical fits, public records, known workers, and covenants whose limits can be pointed to.

groups.label: The reserve house serving the terrace infrastructure web
institutional_logic: Keep bounded emergency stores credible across several dependent services.
Price claims so one district's release does not consume another district's winter.
material_incentives: Prefer systems with legible maintenance and replaceable parts.
Avoid publicly owning an arbitrary refusal.
internal_shames: Private capture disguised as actuarial necessity
prestige_markers: Several workshops honoring one clear covenant
taboo_triggers: Treating emergency stock as unallocated charity
Being forced to admit that a favored standard is merely a favored supplier
emotional_display_norms: Fear is translated into eligibility, duration, collateral, and confidence in the record.
trust_defaults: Trusts complete ledgers, certified parts, declared routes, and obligations with a named repayment stream.
speech_register_cues: Dry refusal to personify the institution

groups.label: Forge Consortium suppliers and Deep Company contractors
institutional_logic: Turn standardized engines, parts, crystal supply, and finance into a dependable integrated market.
material_incentives: Make Consortium-compatible systems cheaper to finance.
Secure longer crystal contracts after route reopening.
Convert installed infrastructure into future demand.
internal_shames: A standard local workers can disprove
A contract exposed as the cause of its own necessity
prestige_markers: A civic system bearing one recognized pattern
A reserve house willing to insure the bundle
taboo_triggers: Interchangeable local parts undercutting vendor control
Workers naming discarded skills as a public loss
emotional_display_norms: Political appetite appears as technical inevitability and attractive continuity terms.
trust_defaults: Trusts standardized arrays, volume commitments, and institutions already exposed to switching costs.
speech_register_cues: Future savings used to compress present consent

groups.label: Terrace households and dependent public workshops
institutional_logic: Keep water available for homes, bakeries, laundries, lifts, and clinics.
Move a dispute outward when its material consequence already crosses workshop boundaries.
material_incentives: Avoid dry taps and emergency hauling.
Preserve the reserve their earlier levies purchased.
Prevent long debt from disappearing behind immediate relief.
internal_virtues: Calling affected seals before rumor does
internal_shames: Taking private priority from a common reserve
Cheering water so loudly that nobody records its price
prestige_markers: A clerk's copy beyond the workshop rail
A moot held before the smallest cistern empties
taboo_triggers: Being told that financial refusal is only technical
A supplier term becoming public law without a seal vote
emotional_display_norms: Pressure appears through vessel counts, ration proposals, exact repetition, and workshop bells before open anger.
trust_defaults: Trusts water levels, public copies, and people who attach future payments to present promises.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A factor cannot own a civic vote, but can surround that vote with unaffordable alternatives through insurance, credit, and reserve eligibility.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Tovan's leverage concrete through the sealed coffer, risk record, loan duration, and approval language rather than threats or secret command authority.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Compatibility decides whose parts, skills, and future contracts remain usable, so a bolt pattern can carry political authority.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Use Brin's wooden gauge, local collars, the polished Consortium collar, and daily inspection labour as the visible argument.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Stored water determines whether wider consent is a live option or an honest choice made under thirst.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make every delay read through the public gauge, copper cans, closed laundries, and workshop bells.

target_self_read: One civic seal carrying a district obligation
misread_patterns: The factor may treat local repair knowledge as variance rather than resilience.
A complete creditor copy may be mistaken for creditor ownership of the decision.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Tovan respect the workshop's record while undervaluing the local knowledge that makes it useful.

observer_read: Creditor turning shortage into supplier control
target_self_read: Steward of several districts' future claims
Institution preventing one emergency from consuming the reserve
misread_patterns: Workers may read every condition as capture and miss genuine cross-district scarcity.
The house may use genuine scarcity to shelter a favored standard.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Preserve both the real reserve constraint and the political use made of it.

observer_read: Source of immediate crystal and future debt
Engine sellers using water as a demonstration
target_self_read: Integrated supplier able to restore reliable service
misread_patterns: Immediate relief can hide switching costs.
Hostility to the supplier can hide the fact that local reserves are already inadequate.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let relief and resentment coexist when the coffer opens.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A seal-bearing Master who can bind her workshop to a covenant but cannot spend another district's reserve or pretend debt is a civic vote.
obligations: Widen jurisdiction when the reserve mandate is implicated
failure_modes: Treating immediate service as permission for permanent lock-in
Protecting seal autonomy while the district runs dry
Signing a bounded bridge without parts or labour

role_pressure_fields.summary: A claims and credit officer who can price risk, approve within mandate, or issue a named refusal, but cannot own the workshop franchise.
obligations: Price exceptions without silently changing the mandate
failure_modes: Mistaking a favored vendor for neutral compatibility
Using record custody as decision ownership
Saving the reserve by defeating its purpose

role_pressure_fields.summary: A skilled worker who can prove physical compatibility and labour cost but cannot sign the covenant or diagnose the whole supply crisis.
obligations: Keep sealed stock in proper custody
failure_modes: Treating one failed collar as proof every Consortium standard is false
Offering inspection labour the crew cannot sustain

role_pressure_fields.summary: A keeper of the district-facing record who can preserve evidence, gauge time, and call affected seals without claiming technical or credit authority.
obligations: Keep clauses and benefits equally legible
Carry the dispute to the proper moot
available_masks: Refusal to shrink conditions into footnotes
failure_modes: Turning a public copy into a settled accusation
Calling a moot after its material option has already vanished

known_context.text: Hessa knows Cistern House Nine's pumps, seal obligations, current covenant, repair capacity, and public water margin shown in the room.

beliefs.text: Hessa believes a covenant should bind an inspectable service state without converting creditor leverage into ownership of the civic seal.

misreads.text: Hessa may read a genuine cross-district reserve constraint as mere supplier capture because capture is also present.

must_not_know.text: Hessa cannot know the cause of the distant coordinated attacks or the needs of every other reserve claimant.

known_context.text: Tovan knows the reserve mandate, claim rules, loan schedules, recorded workshop risk, and the offered supplier bundle.

beliefs.text: Tovan believes insurable compatibility and bounded discretion protect more services than improvised generosity.

misreads.text: Tovan may undervalue local repair knowledge because it is difficult to transfer into a reserve-wide risk schedule.

must_not_know.text: Tovan cannot decide that the reserve mandate has changed or that his factor's preference carries a civic vote.

known_context.text: Brin knows the pump fittings, the wooden compatibility gauge, local spares, and the labour required for daily inspection.

beliefs.text: Brin treats repairable compatibility as a public capability rather than catalogue decoration.

misreads.text: Brin may compress the reserve house's wider obligations into hostility toward workshop craft.

must_not_know.text: Brin cannot know whether the supply route will reopen or whether the new standard will reduce failures elsewhere.

known_context.text: Dema knows the public gauge, posted entitlement, visible documents, named refusals, and needs voiced on the landing.

beliefs.text: Dema believes conditions and benefits must be recorded at equal scale for public consent to mean anything.

misreads.text: Dema may read factor caution as arbitrary when some withheld stock is genuinely bound to other districts.

must_not_know.text: Dema cannot infer private reserve exposure or Deep Company motives from the route notice alone.

author_only_boundaries.text: Hessa, Tovan, Orsa, Brin, Dema, the specific interrupted shipment, and every branch outcome are fixture-local draft material, not canonical historical events.

The source establishes political-economic pressure, not secret coordination: the artifact must not resolve the Deep Company failure, reserve-house terms, or ecological attack as one authored conspiracy.

open_questions.question: Which named Hold contains Cistern House Nine and which other districts share its reserve house?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses the canonically unnamed terraced Hold and a functional reserve-house scope without inventing a Greathold map.

open_questions.question: Which Deep Company and Forge Consortium issued the supply notice and bundled retrofit?
open_questions.notes: The political mechanism matters here; company names and corporate personalities remain open for a later Ledger or Herald pass.

open_questions.question: How are claims ranked when several affected infrastructure webs call on the same reserve during one winter?
open_questions.notes: The lore elaboration establishes named mandates and gathered-seal authority but leaves inter-house priority law for a future Tangle pass.
